title: Make JSON text
summary: PHP: Make JSON text. Add a name key to the array.
introduction: JSON is a text format for data. json_encode turns this small array into JSON.
learningObjectives: Add a name key to the array

blocks.text: Install PHP 8.2 or later. Save each example as lesson.php and run php lesson.php. These are local programs, not a server for this learning site.
The PHP pair becomes one JSON field. JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR reports encoding failures.
Add a name key to the array.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: JSON uses quoted field names; let the tool make the text.
